output.label: partially_supported
output.reason: The spans support that there is a bank policy charging 2% plus GST on principal outstanding for all term-loan foreclosures, and that RBI allows pre-payment charges only as per a UCB’s approved policy in residual cases. However, the cited spans do not show that this policy is the approved policy applicable to the specific MSE business-loan sanction letter, nor do they directly establish that the sanction-letter wording (2% on the amount prepaid) is identical to or matched by the policy wording (2% on principal outstanding).
